name: Noclip - Input Buffer Lab
description: Experimental wave input buffering. Includes exact-delay test mode and an unverified collision-based predictor. Automatically bypasses dual and CBF.

enabled.name: Enable input correction (OFF by default)
enabled.description: Experimental. Turn on only when testing a copy or practice level. Gameplay is assisted.

max-wave-ticks.name: Wave correction limit (physics ticks)
max-wave-ticks.description: Maximum predictive wave input delay. 4 ticks is about 16.7ms at 240 TPS.

lookahead-ticks.name: Prediction lookahead (physics ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: Only approximate static hazard collision prediction. Larger values can wrongly reject future multi-click wave corridors.

fixed-delay-test.name: Diagnostic: force exact delay
fixed-delay-test.description: Disables prediction and buffers every single-player wave press AND release for exactly N physics ticks. Use only in a safe test level to verify that input interception and delivery actually work.

fixed-delay-ticks.name: Diagnostic delay amount (ticks)
fixed-delay-ticks.description: Used only with Diagnostic: force exact delay.

debug-logging.name: Log every buffered input and prediction
debug-logging.description: See original tick, selected delay, predicted survival score, dispatch tick, and observed button held state in geode/logs.

f6-cycle.name: F6 cycles stages (2/4/8/8/OFF)
f6-cycle.description: Temporary max-delay stage selection until restart. Stage OFF fully disables correction, even if Enable is on.
